cs.t: I'm surprised Grado is at this high position at all - their production quality is absolutely abysmal, they came apart in a year - unlike Sennheiser (using for few years), Audiotechica (using for few years) and Technics/Panasonic (these I use for 15 years!). As for the cost - for same money there is always better alternative than Grados.

cs.t: I have a complete setup from the 70s. NAD 3045 with new acoustic design on the panel, technics record player and Braun speakers. Sound super super good. The increase in soundquality since that tech is marginal at best. The biggest improvement regarding class-D amps is power consumption and weight.
